title: Created with single tool
description: A trov:createdWith, where one is present, names one software tool that generated the declaration, given as a node or a reference to one. It is not the system that assembled the TRO, which trov:wasAssembledBy names.
summary: A `trov:createdWith` names one software tool, given as a node

errorMessage.not: a TRO names one software tool in trov:createdWith, not an array of them

errorMessage.type: a software tool is given as a node or a reference, {"@id": ...}, not as a string
